title: Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.12997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult. This paper asks if an unsupervised representation trained on patent text can recover relevant connections that code-restricted search cannot, and if hyperbolic space helps. We trained a hyperbolic and a matched Euclidean Variational Autoencoder (VAE) on 45,000 US patents (96 runs, 6 seeds). The hyperbolic model retrieves genuinely cross-category prior art 52% more often than the Euclidean model (18.76% vs. 12.34% of top-10 results, 3,000 queries). This represents a practical gain for the motivating search problem. The hyperbolic model agrees less with official classification (NMI 0.2392 vs. 0.3206), which we explain geometrically: the two measures capture different goals, and only one aligns with prior-art search needs. translated_title: 面向无监督专利权利要求分类的嵌入几何与聚类算法基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有技术检索系统在结构上是围绕分类代码组织的，这使得跨代码的发现变得困难。本文探究在专利文本上训练的无监督表示能否恢复受代码限制的搜索无法发现的相关联系，以及双曲空间是否有所帮助。我们在45,000件美国专利上训练了双曲和对应的欧几里得变分自编码器（VAE）（96次运行，6个随机种子）。双曲模型检索到真正跨类别现有技术的频率比欧几里得模型高52%（在前10个结果中分别为18.76%对12.34%，共3,000个查询）。这对本文所针对的检索问题而言是一个实用性增益。双曲模型与官方分类的一致性较低（NMI分别为0.2392对0.3206），我们从几何角度对此进行了解释：这两种度量捕捉的目标不同，只有其中之一与现有技术检索的需求相契合。在对10个技术领域（另有50,000件专利）的研究中，我们发现一个领域的分类……
tldr: 双曲空间嵌入能显著提升跨分类代码的现有技术检索能力——双曲VAE比欧几里得VAE多检索到52%的真正跨类别现有技术，尽管它与官方专利分类系统的一致性更低。
en_tdlr: Hyperbolic embeddings substantially improve cross-code prior-art retrieval—a hyperbolic VAE finds genuinely cross-category prior art 52% more often than a matched Euclidean VAE, despite aligning less with official patent classifications.
